prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1167; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in a collision that occurred in a parking lot and involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office, and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

Our client sustained injuries in this incident and is entitled to compensation for medical expenses, lost income, and pain and suffering. To evaluate the claim properly, we request a written disclosure of all liability limits applicable under the policy, including any excess or umbrella coverage known to you.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data, witness statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, and any recorded statements. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
